lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white circular clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, forming a grid-like spatial distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of higher pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance spots, creating anchor nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge running horizontally across the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with a high-luminance dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single commensal organism (remora) is visible attached to the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct transition to significantly smaller and more densely packed high-luminance spots on the cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit.
